column1: # W54: representative choice at the NESTING level (tab:ablation-modules panel b).
# WHY. Panel (b) currently compares stride against medoid on single-step
# grounding only, which exercises GEOPACT_CRS_REP, the current-frame pass of
# Eq. (stride). The retirement pass of Eq. (medoid) is governed by a separate
# flag, GEOPACT_CRS_NESTED_REP, and single-step evaluation has no retiring frame,
# so the published panel says nothing about it. That is a real gap, because the
# adopted architecture deliberately uses different geometry at the two levels
# (stride for the current frame, medoid at nesting) and the table as written
# invites the opposite reading.
# The claim in geopact_crs.py that stride loses 1.05 points at the nesting level
# has no run behind it: no job TSV has ever set CRS_NESTED_REP, and the
# similarly-named logs/xds8b_abl/omnigui/nested_stride05_c50_h10 arm sets
# CRS_REP with SKEL_FRAC=0.05, so it is a single-step-flag probe at a different
# dose and cannot serve as the nesting control. These rows measure it properly.
# ANCHORS. Cloned verbatim from the adopted main-table arms, changing only
# CRS_NESTED_REP, so each delta reads against the number the paper already
# reports (OmniGUI GP 27.35 mild / 20.02 tight):
#   mild  <- logs/xds8b_full/{ds}/main_c50_h10
#   tight <- logs/xds8b_full/{ds}/main_c25_h05
# The medoid side needs no new run: it IS the adopted arm.
# BENCHMARK|TASK|TRACK|EXP_ARM|RATIO|HIST_N|OUT|LIMIT|EXTRA_ENV
